title: Vitenzi Vishirikishi (Theme 7: Kuhudumia jamii shuleni)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child uses the linking verb that fits: ni / si for identity, -ko/-po/-mo for place by class (yuko, kiko), and ndi- + class for emphasis.
representations: a place table by class (yuko, kiko, liko)

board.say: Ni mahali; kitabu kiko katika ngeli ipi?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Kitabu kiko mezani" and "Kitabu hiki ndicho changu".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni kitenzi kishirikishi kipi cha kukanusha?" Kwa nini "ni" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Si ni kishirikishi cha kukanusha; ni cha kuthibitisha.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kamilisha: Wanafunzi ___ darasani." Kwa nini "yuko" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Wanafunzi ni wengi, kwa hiyo tunasema wako.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Neno sio katika "Huyu sio mwalimu" linaonyesha nini?" Kwa nini "kuthibitisha" si jibu sahihi?

misconceptions.repair: Kishirikishi ndi- hupatana na nomino: kitabu ndicho.
